summary: Verified the sixth reported instance of the denylist-with-unconditional-pass-fallthrough defect myself before changing anything: src/health/service.ts's gate() reads latest.gate.status from an on-disk latest.json through an unchecked `as HealthReport` cast in readLatest(), so an unrecognized/corrupted status string is reachable at runtime even though GateStatus (pass|warn|incomplete|fail, src/health/types.ts) closes the type. Confirmed reachability with a hand-written fixture (gate.status: "banana") read back through the real readLatest() parse path, and confirmed with a RED run that the pre-fix fold returned exitCode 0 for it instead of 1. The report was correct. Added an exported gateExitCode(status, strictWarn) helper: an exhaustive switch over GateStatus with the default arm on the blocking side, mirroring runExitCode (src/commands/health.ts), isPassGate (src/commands/security.ts), runGate's switch (src/security/service.ts) and securityFlowGate (src/security/guard.ts) in shape only, over health's own GateStatus vocabulary, no cross-module import. gate() now delegates its exitCode computation to this helper instead of the inline denylist; the status field itself is unchanged (still a pass-through of latest.gate.status). All four recognized values are byte-identical to before (truth table); only the previously-reachable-but-unenumerated fallthrough changes, from exit 0 to exit 1, in both strictWarn true and false. New src/health/service-gate-exit.test.ts adds 4 tests / 17 expect() calls: pass control, fail/incomplete unconditional blocking, warn at both strictWarn settings (asserting status stays "warn", never relabeled "pass"), and the unrecognized-value fixture. RED-before/GREEN-after verified by running the tests before and after the code change (not a revert-in-place, since the test file was written first per TDD).

acceptance.criterion: AC4 / AFC-05: fixtures, a corrupted payload, a skipped required check and an incomplete area each produce the expected outcome, and violations are not lost when another check is unavailable.
acceptance.evidence: incomplete (required-source-unavailable) and fail block unconditionally before and after this fix, pinned in the truth table and the unmodified src/commands/health-incomplete.test.ts (still green, raw 2026-09-06T15-24-10-048Z_run.log). The new corrupted-payload case (an unrecognized gate.status string in a hand-written latest.json fixture, read through the real readLatest() parse path) now blocks (exitCode 1) instead of silently passing (raw 2026-09-06T15-23-57-657Z_run.log, GREEN).

acceptance.criterion: No health gate value that should block is treated as a pass by this method; the default arm blocks; an optional skip still warns and is never signed as passed.
acceptance.evidence: gateExitCode's switch is exhaustive with default: return 1. Truth table: all four recognized values byte-identical to before; the unrecognized-value case inverts 0 -> 1 at both strictWarn settings (raw 2026-09-06T15-23-35-145Z_run.log RED -> 2026-09-06T15-23-57-657Z_run.log GREEN). skippedOptional never sets GateStatus in computeGate (src/health/gate.ts, read-only, traced directly) so optional-skip warnings are untouched; the warn case's status field is asserted to stay "warn" (not.toBe("pass")) directly in the new test.

acceptance.criterion: Regressions fail before the change and pass after; the health suites stay green and no currently passing invocation stops passing.
